title: Resolve Two Conflicting Files
objective: Merge a release branch while resolving conflicts in both configuration and review policy.
description: Main introduces a manual review and a longer timeout. The release branch introduces automated review and a still longer timeout. Resolve both files, keep both review methods, and finish one merge commit.

lesson.principle: A merge can pause on several files at once. Check git status until every unmerged path is resolved and staged.
lesson.question: After fixing config.txt, Git still lists review.txt as unmerged. What should you do before committing?
lesson.explanation: The merge cannot be completed while any path remains unmerged. Resolve and stage both files before the commit.
pitfalls: Fixing only the first conflicted file.
Leaving conflict markers in either file.

hints: Run git merge feature/release, then git status. Two files need attention.
Set config.txt to timeout=60. Make review.txt express both manual and automated review.
Stage both files with git add config.txt review.txt, commit, then run check.
